title: Covenant Courier delivery envelope v1
description: The signed artifact a product delivery frame carries: the product message, its policy decision and the payload. Written as canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact, LF). The transport signature (ssh-keygen -Y sign, namespace courier/message) covers these exact bytes. The receiver recomputes payload_sha256 and checks it against message.payload_sha256 and the sender's product receipt. Exactly one payload form: payload_b64 (plaintext) or payload_vtp2_b64 (encrypted, required by profiles with payload_encryption vtp2; a receiver never accepts payload_b64 on a session that has a VTP v2 binding).

covenant_gate_decision.description: Present when Covenant Gate allowed the delivery and signed its decision. decision_b64: the exact covenantgate.eval_output.v1 bytes; signature_b64: the ssh-keygen -Y sign signature over them (namespace covenant-gate/decision); signer: the profile's covenant_gate_signer. A receiver whose own profile requires the gate refuses an envelope without it, and checks signer, input_hash (rebuilt from the message), decision allow and the pinned policy_hash.

payload_vtp2_b64.description: Base64 of a vtp.message.v3 envelope (spec/VTP_V2_SECURITY_PROTOCOL.md) carrying the payload under the VTP v2 session bound to message.session_id (covenant_courier.vtp2_binding.v1). The receiver decrypts with the recipient node's device state and recomputes message.payload_sha256 over the plaintext.
